pages.title: Block
pages.text: Certain blocks can be Implements. You can use a block Implement to place copies of that block some number of times before the Implement needs to be refilled using your Self.$(br2)In addition, you will find it much easier to break blocks of that type.

When viewing a block's spiritual composition in JEI, Implement-eligible blocks will be annotated with a red number beneath a block icon indicating how many of that block can be placed between refills.$(br2)A lava bucket Implement will place lava as if it were a block Implement.
